note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: lessons
datasets.select: SELECT id,course_id,status,learned_sections,latest_section_id,latest_learn_time,create_time,expire_time FROM learning_lesson WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_lesson WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: progress
datasets.select: SELECT id,lesson_id,section_id,moment,finished,create_time,finish_time FROM learning_record WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_record WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: notes
datasets.select: SELECT id,course_id,section_id,moment,content,deleted,created_at,updated_at FROM course_note WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_note WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_note WHERE user_id=? AND updated_at<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE course_note SET content='[已清理]',deleted=1 WHERE user_id=? AND updated_at<?

datasets.name: questions
datasets.select: SELECT id,title,description,course_id,section_id,status,create_time FROM interaction_question WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_question WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_question WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE interaction_question SET title='已注销学员的提问',description='[已清理]',hidden=1,anonymity=1 WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?

datasets.name: replies
datasets.select: SELECT id,question_id,content,create_time FROM interaction_reply WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_reply WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_reply WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE interaction_reply SET content='[已清理]',hidden=1,anonymity=1 WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?

datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_favorite WHERE user_id=?

datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_record WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: practice_submissions
datasets.select: SELECT id,course_id,revision,assignment_version,description,work_url,status,feedback,submitted_at,reviewed_at FROM learning_practice_submission WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_practice_submission WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_practice_submission WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(reviewed_at,submitted_at)<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE learning_practice_submission SET description='[已清理]',work_url=NULL,feedback=NULL,cleaned_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(reviewed_at,submitted_at)<?

datasets.name: classroom_memberships
datasets.select: SELECT m.id,m.class_id,c.name,m.course_id,m.order_id,m.state,m.joined_at,m.ended_at FROM teaching_class_member m JOIN teaching_class c ON c.id=m.class_id WHERE m.user_id=? ORDER BY m.id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_member WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: classroom_grades
datasets.select: SELECT g.member_id,g.activity_id,a.title,g.score,g.feedback,g.published_at FROM teaching_class_grade g JOIN teaching_class_activity a ON a.id=g.activity_id WHERE g.user_id=? ORDER BY g.member_id,g.activity_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_grade WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: classroom_results
datasets.select: SELECT member_id,class_id,total_percent,passed,finalized_at FROM teaching_class_result WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY member_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_result WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: classroom_submissions
datasets.select: SELECT id,activity_id,member_id,assignment_version,revision,description,work_url,state,score,feedback,submitted_at FROM teaching_class_submission WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_submission WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_submission s JOIN teaching_class_member m ON m.id=s.member_id WHERE s.user_id=? AND s.cleaned_at IS NULL AND m.state NOT IN ('ACTIVE','HELD') AND s.submitted_at<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE teaching_class_submission s JOIN teaching_class_member m ON m.id=s.member_id SET s.description='[已清理]',s.work_url=NULL,s.feedback=NULL,s.cleaned_at=NOW(3) WHERE s.user_id=? AND s.cleaned_at IS NULL AND m.state NOT IN ('ACTIVE','HELD') AND s.submitted_at<?

datasets.name: classroom_discussions
datasets.select: SELECT id,class_id,parent_id,section_id,title,body,staff_reply,posted_at FROM teaching_class_discussion WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_discussion WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_discussion WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL AND posted_at<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE teaching_class_discussion SET title=NULL,body='[已清理]',cleaned_at=NOW(3) WHERE user_id=? AND cleaned_at IS NULL AND posted_at<?

datasets.name: operations

datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
